stil: Masterful, highly detailed fantasy illustration in the style of official Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook art: painterly digital painting, sharp focus, intricate textures, cinematic lighting with strong contrast and deep shadows, rich saturated colors, muted jungle greens and teal with warm golden accents. Professional quality, crisp, not washed out. Landscape 16:9 composition. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no border.

bilder.prompt: Exactly four silent servants stand side by side in a row on a jungle path at dusk. Each is wrapped from head to toe in a long, shapeless hooded robe like a crude bathrobe, roughly sewn from a heap of stolen orc clothing: patched furs, coarse dark cloth and leather scraps. Deep hoods hide their faces completely in black shadow; no face is visible. Their hands are wrapped in dirty cloth strips. From left to right: the first holds a heavy rusty orcish axe, the second an orcish axe and a plain knife, the third a plain knife, the fourth a short wooden bow with a quiver of arrows on its back. On the shoulder of each servant sits one bird: a toucan with a big colorful beak, a bright green and red parrot, an astral owl with silvery-blue feathers sparkling with tiny stars, and a falcon. In the background a silver fish leaps out of a dark jungle river. Faint green magical glow and fireflies. Eerie and mysterious, loyal bodyguards standing perfectly still.

A huge herbivorous dinosaur-like beast about four and a half meters tall, similar to a stegosaurus, but with a single row of crest-like scale plates that runs only from the top of its head down to the base of its neck; its back has no plates. It strides through a dense tropical jungle, crushing the undergrowth and leaving a wide trail of flattened plants. Exactly five clearly distinct adventurers ride bareback on its broad back, from front to back: (1) an astral elf wizard with long silver hair and a long silver beard, wearing a deep green hood and a cloak decorated with leaves, faint green glowing magic at his fingertips; (2) Kho, a female red dragonborn barbarian with curved dark horns, a long braid and a long dragon tail hanging down the beast's side, holding her skull-topped magical scythe; (3) a cheerful satyr bard with goat legs and small horns, holding a small magical keyboard instrument with glowing keys; (4) a tiefling warlock woman with curved horns, a thin tail and dark elegant clothes, holding a tiny baby dragon against her chest; (5) a sea elf paladin with blue-green skin in shining silver-blue armor with a shield. Alucasia, a tiny fairy ranger only sixty centimeters tall with dark brown skin, long lilac hair and pink-violet butterfly wings, flies beside the beast's head with her bow. Golden afternoon light falls through the canopy.

referenzen.was: Valerius, the astral elf wizard with long silver hair and beard in a green hood
Kho, the red dragonborn barbarian (Storm Herald of the sea) with her skull-topped scythe

bilder.prompt: Six lean humanoid hunters stand in a misty swamp jungle. Their faces and bodies look human, but their arms are covered in scales and their hands end in sharp claws. They wear dark practical hunting clothes. Their leader in front is taller and has a long heavy lizard tail. Cold, calculating expressions. A faint sickly violet glow of soul magic flickers around the leader's clawed hand. In the far background, fallen lizardfolk warriors lie half hidden in the reeds and mist, not gory.

A surreal dreamlike void filled with dense white fog. In it stands an endless room of identical plain wooden doors, all exactly alike, some slightly ajar with soft light behind them. Alone in the fog, an astral elf wizard with long silver hair and a long silver beard, wearing a deep green hood and a cloak decorated with leaves, faint green glowing magic at his fingertips, reaches for one of the door handles. Quiet, unsettling, mysterious.

referenzen.was: Valerius, the astral elf wizard with long silver hair and beard in a green hood

bilder.prompt: Night at the edge of a jungle where it meets a moonlit desert of rolling dunes. Among the last trees stands a small opaque magical dome, colored in jungle camouflage greens and browns so that it blends into the foliage. About a hundred meters away out on the sand burns a small campfire of three lurking scaly figures, one of them standing watch and staring into the dark. Starry sky, tense and quiet atmosphere.

A cozy improvised wilderness workshop at night beside a campfire at the edge of a jungle, no people. A fallen log serves as a workbench with alchemist's glass flasks and a small burner, bundles of drying herbs and roots, cured hides and strips of leather being stitched into a leather armor, a half finished leather saddle, rolls of rough cloth with needle and thread, lianas coiled like rope. One of the tools glows faintly with green magic, as if it was conjured.

Alucasia, a tiny fey ranger only sixty centimeters tall: dark brown skin, long wavy lilac-pink hair with violet flowers and a fine silver circlet with a violet gem, pointed ears, pink eyes, a delicate nose ring. Large translucent butterfly wings shimmering in pink, violet and blue, with little chains of crystal drops hanging from them. She wears brown leather ranger armor with golden filigree and tall boots and carries an elegant bow decorated with flowers and a quiver of pink-fletched arrows. She hovers among giant jungle leaves and flowers, nocking an arrow, with a mischievous, curious look. Dappled golden light.

A tiefling warlock woman with curved horns and a tail, in dark elegant traveling clothes, faint eldritch magic glowing at her fingertips. A small dragon companion sits curled against her chest. She looks knowing and slightly amused, as if she could read your thoughts. Jungle river at dusk behind her.

A cheerful male satyr bard with goat legs and small horns sits by a campfire at a jungle river and plays a small magical keyboard instrument: a portable enchanted keyboard with softly glowing keys that floats in the air in front of him, music notes of light drifting up. A storyteller who collects tales, warm firelight on his face. He is alone, no other people.

A sea elf paladin and traveling ambassador: a lean elf with pale blue-green skin, long dark hair flowing like seaweed and calm, righteous eyes, wearing polished silver-blue plate armor with wave and ocean motifs, a shield and a holy symbol. He stands on a jungle riverbank, light reflecting from the water.

Full-body action portrait of Kho, a powerful female dragonborn barbarian, a Storm Herald of the sea. Deep red-orange scales, curved dark ram-like horns, a long dark braid, golden eyes, a long muscular dragon tail. She wears a brown leather top, leather bracers, a fur-trimmed loincloth with a skull belt buckle and metal knee guards. She wields her large magical scythe with a skull at the top of the shaft; crackling blue-white lightning runs down the shaft. Around her swirls a storm aura of lightning, wind and sea spray, ocean waves crash against black rocks behind her. Fierce, loyal protector, her face clearly visible.

referenzen.was: Kho, the red dragonborn barbarian (Storm Herald of the sea) with her skull-topped scythe
Kho again, close-up of her face, horns, braid and scythe

bilder.fuer: Welt: Die Riesen · Journal: Riesen in der Nacht
bilder.prompt: Night attack on a frontier town with a wooden palisade beside a jungle river: two mountain giants with craggy, rock-grey skin and one much larger frost giant with pale blue skin, an icy beard and fur armor stride out of the dark jungle edge. One of the giants carries a huge greatsword engraved with two softly glowing magical runes. Torches and fires burn along the palisade, tiny defenders on the walls give a sense of enormous scale. Dramatic moonlight and firelight.

bilder.fuer: Welt: Die Orcs · Journal: Die Verschwundenen und die Orcs am Fluss
bilder.prompt: A band of muscular orc warriors on a jungle riverbank, each marked with a glowing magical rune brand burned into the skin of the shoulder or chest. Wary and oppressed, they haul and stack huge piles of timber. In the misty distance the silhouette of a giant watches over them. Overcast light, tense and grim mood, not gory.

A wise and powerful lizardfolk woman whose scales shimmer pearlescent like mother-of-pearl, a priestess or mage of a lizardfolk clan that paints itself with red pigment. She wears ritual adornments of bone, feathers and red paint and holds a carved staff, faint magic glowing in her other hand. She stands at the entrance of an underground sanctuary carved into a jungle hill. Calm, commanding presence.

Saladin, a djinn and merchant of wonders: blue skin, a bald head with a single high black topknot, pointed ears, a short black goatee and a broad confident smile. Muscular bare chest under an open indigo robe richly embroidered in gold, glowing cyan runes run along the robe's edges, a golden sash and golden rings. He stands behind the counter of his cluttered shop of wonders full of colorful potions, glowing crystal balls, scrolls, books and brass lanterns, holding a radiant golden magic lamp in one hand. Warm candlelight.

referenzen.was: Saladin, the blue djinn merchant, in his shop
Saladin again, smiling with crossed arms

bilder.prompt: A lone ancient stone tower rising from the middle of a misty jungle lake. On its flat top stands an enormous throne built for a giant. Faint magical light glows in seams of the tower walls, and a broken arcane seal shimmers in the air above the throne. The deep, dark water around the tower hints at something huge beneath the surface. Twilight, mysterious and grand.

A young frontier settlement on a jungle river, seen from above at a slight angle: an upper ring and a lower ring of concentric fortifications, the lower ring with a new wooden palisade, a stately villa, a small arena and a tall stone tower. In the upper ring stands an unfinished house with scaffolding. Outside the lower ring, lizardfolk tents and campfires. Boats on the river, warm morning light, a sense of hope and hard work.

A mysterious masked monk master in plain dark robes, his face hidden behind a smooth, featureless mask, kneels at night in a misty old-world forest beside a freshly uncovered hidden grave and examines a torn, embroidered cloak. He follows every trail like a bloodhound. Lantern light, cold mist, tense and ominous mood, not gory.

Devil hunters of a secret mage society: three sorcerers in dark uniforms stand around a glowing summoning circle in a dark stone chamber. They bind a horned demon in chains of light and draw its power out of it as a stream of violet soul light into a crystal. Ominous, powerful and morally dark.

bilder.fuer: Welt: Die belagerte Stadt im Westen
bilder.prompt: A walled city in the desert under siege by giants: huge giants hurl boulders at sandstone walls while defenders hold the battlements. On the tallest tower a commanding noblewoman in armor directs the archers. Dunes and the ruins of a temple with elephant-headed statues in the distance. Sunset, dust and smoke, heroic and defiant mood.

A cunning forger of identities and papers in his cramped workshop in a rainy old-world harbor city at night: an older man with ink-stained fingers and spectacles, seen half from behind, bent over forged documents, wax seals, stamps, a magnifying glass and noble crests, candles burning low. Secretive, clever mood.
